variant_decisions.evidence: ASV renders the particle as the negative: "I will not keep silence concerning his limbs". That negation can only come from the ketiv לא; the qere לֽוֹ is the prepositional "to/for him", which would leave the clause unnegated ("concerning him I will keep silence") and contradict the ASV wording. The ASV verse itself therefore distinguishes the reading.
